name: LightPanel
tagline: Modular red and near-infrared panels. One, two or four.
description: The OneBase LightPanel is targeted red light therapy that scales. High-density 660 nm red and 850 nm near-infrared LEDs in a heat-managed chassis, with a touch interface for intensity and timer. Start with a Solo, stack to a Duo or Quad on a stand that runs horizontal or vertical for whole-body sessions.

highlights.title: Dual-spectrum coverage
highlights.body: Precision-calibrated 660 nm red and 850 nm near-infrared for topical skin rejuvenation and deep-tissue recovery.

highlights.title: High irradiance, managed heat
highlights.body: Robust chassis with integrated cooling sinks prevents overheating across extended sessions.

highlights.title: Touch control
highlights.body: Granular control over intensity and session duration; control from the panel or the OneBase app.

highlights.title: Low EMF, energy efficient
highlights.body: Safe for frequent use with a low operating cost.

highlights.title: Modular and portable
highlights.body: Compact panels with mounting options and adjustable stands for multi-panel sets.

faqs.a: Yes. Solo panels have mounting options; Duo and Quad sets ship with an adjustable stand that can be configured horizontally or vertically.

seoTitle: OneBase LightPanel — Modular Red Light Therapy Panels
seoDescription: High-density 660/850 nm red and near-infrared panels. Solo, Duo and Quad configurations with touch control and app connectivity.
